text:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Android Developer position at Ember Mobility. As a frontend developer with experience building mobile applications, I am eager to contribute to your team. 

My background includes developing a recipe finder app in React Native with offline favourites, which is published on the Play Store and has reached over 1,000 installs. While my core experience is in React, TypeScript, and React Native, I am keen to apply my frontend development skills and transition into native Android development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. 

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background in building user-focused applications aligns with the needs at Ember Mobility. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
Alex Rao
